title: Ревность Насти к новому другу  (Nastya's Jealousy Over the New Friend)

segments.t: Pulling Kostya aside in the hallway, Nastya is furious that he wants to go out drinking at karaoke with a homeless man instead of staying home with her. When Kostya defends Rodion as their new friend, an exasperated Nastya marches back into the kitchen and tells Rodion Sergeyevich that he has to leave.
Костя, как ты будешь с ним дружить?
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'We are going to karaoke.' In Russian, the idea of 'we' flows naturally into 'karaoke' without extra filler words. Nastya answers right away.
'Why are you looking at me like that?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'me'.
'By the way, I was wrong about him.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'by the way' before landing on 'wrong'.
'About Rodion Sergeyevich?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Rodion' and finishing on 'Sergeyevich'. Nastya answers right away.
'And now he is our friend.' Nastya brings out the contrast between 'both' and 'he' in a few short words.
'Since when?' Rodion anchors the line on 'with', while 'times' completes the thought.
Костя, как ты будешь с ним дружить?
'Kostya, how can you be friends with him?' In Russian, the idea of 'Kostya' flows naturally into 'be friends' without extra filler words. Nastya answers right away.
'Well, he is kind of...' Nastya anchors the line on 'come on', while 'would' completes the thought.
'Kind of homeless.' In Russian, the idea of 'how' flows naturally into 'homeless man' without extra filler words.
'Nastya, I beg of you.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Nastya' and 'I beg' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Nastya answers right away.
'Everyone has their own little flaws, Nastenka.' The grammar packs 'by' and 'flaws' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I know him too.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'know'.

'Rodion Sergeyevich, it would be best for you to leave.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Rodion' and finishing on 'to leave'. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Костя, как ты будешь с ним дружить?

That wraps up this scene as upset that Kostya wants to go partying at karaoke with Rodion instead of spending the evening with her, Nastya reverses course and tells Rodion it is time for him to leave. Until next time!
